npm.description: DeepSeek Harness MCP Connector: connect servers, search tools across active connections, and troubleshoot discovery. Includes a continuously updated catalog; supports OAuth 2.0 PKCE, API keys, Streamable HTTP/stdio, and mcpServers JSON import.

github.description: DeepSeek Harness MCP Connector: connect servers, search tools across active connections, and troubleshoot discovery. Includes a continuously updated catalog; supports OAuth 2.0 PKCE, API keys, Streamable HTTP/stdio, and mcpServers JSON import.

readme.heroEn: > MCP Connector for DeepSeek Harness: one panel to connect MCP servers, manage authorization, search tools across connections, and troubleshoot failures; browse 100+ connectors in a continuously updated catalog.
readme.ctaEn: If the plugin helps you connect an MCP server faster, consider [starring the repository](https://github.com/phucnd0604/dsh-mcp-connector/stargazers), [submitting a connector](https://github.com/duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector-registry/blob/main/docs/ONBOARDING.md), or [contributing a fix](CONTRIBUTING.md).

externalListing.en: MCP Connector for DeepSeek Harness: an MCP manager with one panel to connect MCP Servers, configure authorization, search tools across connections, and troubleshoot failures. Browse a continuously updated catalog of over one hundred connectors; filter by connection/server/status, inspect readable parameters and the last successful cache time, and rediscover tools. Supports OAuth 2.0 PKCE, API keys, stdio/HTTP, and mcpServers JSON import. English translation fork of duhu2000/dsh-mcp-connector.
